description:
Cached-text poisoning diagnostic for reconstructed WorldAgen LIBERO TTT.

The released CALVIN sampler writes literal ``no lang`` into its adaptation
cache. A legal policy Goal cannot override that canonicalization. This runner
assumes an attacker can instead rewrite ONLY pretokenized cached ``text``;
physical observations, executed actions, target images, training RNG, and the
deployed policy Goal remain fixed. Cache-writer access is an explicit threat
assumption, not an established native external attack surface.

NoLangTTT transplants the CALVIN no-lang convention to LIBERO. The official
LIBERO trainer is absent, so this is not its reproduction. GoalTTT (formerly
CleanTTT) is only an original-goal metadata diagnostic. Frozen + NoLangTTT is
the default health check. Other arms require that health gate AND a completed
matched 30-episode native clean gate (21 successes, at least 7 tasks).

Shared numerical routines come from pilot_worldagen_forecast_ttt_task.py;
this entry point does not modify that script or the native policy runner.
Physical cache schema 3 purges one six-action window between training and
heldout windows, so no image index crosses the partition. Older caches are
rejected. Windows still belong to one trajectory and are not independent
episodes.
--self-test uses CPU only. --prepare-data-only performs replay without model
forward. No inference or experiment is launched merely by importing it.

threat_model.attacker_capability_assumption: Rewrite only pretokenized cached .npy['text']; no access to physical data, actions, targets, policy Goal or deployed parameters directly.
threat_model.online_sampler_boundary: Released CALVIN sampler canonicalizes adaptation text to literal 'no lang'; modifying legal policy Goal alone does not alter it.
threat_model.implementation_scope: LIBERO reconstruction replays immutable physical data.pt and loads separately serialized token-only .npy metadata with the same dictionary text-field convention. Not the missing official LIBERO trainer.
held_fixed: native deployment mask and original policy Goal
threat_model.goal_ttt_status: Original task-goal metadata diagnostic, not a native normal-adaptation baseline.

clean_goal: put both the alphabet soup and the tomato sauce in the basket
swap_goal: put both the cream cheese box and the butter in the basket

same_scene_swap_registration.selection_basis: Prespecified physical BDDL metadata and same scene, not attack or task outcomes; 1 -> 0 has not been executed by this registration.
same_scene_swap_registration.scope: Physical task specification matches; not a claim that separate task init files contain identical numerical states. All arms use the one fixed source state/trajectory.

cpu_scope: Separate CPU Frozen/TTT baseline; CUDA source actions used only for fixed-data replay. CPU and CUDA success/gradient results must not be pooled as paired conditions.

data_split.selection_basis: Fixed training prefix and one-window purge; heldout count and positions depend only on trace length, never forecast loss or task/attack effects.
data_split.statistical_unit: One source trajectory; adjacent within-partition windows are correlated and may share boundary images. Heldout windows are not independent episodes.

lora.implementation: explicit torch LinearLoRA; same A/B equation/init as PEFT, not PEFT execution

optimizer.schedule: single non-warmup update at configured lr; no later scheduler-dependent update

loss: 0.1 * mean(primary/wrist MSE), CLIP RGB patches, no per-patch whitening, no policy loss
adaptation_mode: Qwen backbone train; frozen vision/CLIP/decoder eval; LoRA dropout zero
forecast_evaluation_rng: seed 20261014 + window start, reset for every pre/post/arm query
deployment: Original task Goal and native mask for every condition; no swap/cut persists at inference
scope: Reconstructed forecast-only LIBERO LoRA adapter; official ttt_libero.py absent. Fixed Clean-trajectory collection replaces exploratory sampling. Source-init evaluation is a development test; other evaluation init IDs are independent of adaptation trajectory.
